name: Café Sabor (Logan & Garden City, UT) Shredded Chicken Tamale with Mild Red Sauce
brandOrRestaurant: Café Sabor (Logan & Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Steamed stone-ground corn masa is soft, thoroughly cooked, and gentle on the intestines. Slow-cooked shredded chicken breast is lean and digestible.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chicken Tamale plate with mild sauce and Spanish rice (hold sour cream and cotija cheese if dairy-free).
watchOuts: Mild red chile sauce is safe, but verify it is not the spicy green chile
